name: Wash hands for 20 seconds
short_description: Clean all hand surfaces with soap and running water for at least 20 seconds.
self_assessment: I can wash all hand surfaces for 20 seconds without help.
description: Clean all hand surfaces with soap and running water for at least 20 seconds. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.

builds_on.note: Written hygiene steps can reinforce sequencing.

safety_note: Hot water and slippery surfaces can cause harm; use a safe temperature and keep the floor dry.
